answer: Blind shuffle grading: each epoch, answers are stripped of author keys and drawn like marbles from a bag, so every grader gets a random handful it cannot choose. Graders post a bond, and anyone whose scores for one hidden cluster drift far above the crowd median loses it. A sybil farm can't steer marbles toward its own keys; its quiet whisper of mutual favoritism is drowned by a gale of independent scores, so cheating means bribing a majority of random strangers.
